## Exercise 1

### a) 

```{r}

setClass("waldCI", slots = c(
  confidence_level = "numeric",
  mean = "numeric",
  sterr = "numeric",
  lb = "numeric",
  ub = "numeric"
  ))

setValidity("waldCI", function(object) {
  if (object@confidence_level > 1) {
    stop("confidence_level too high")
  }
  if (object@confidence_level < 0) {
    stop("confidence_level too high")
  }
  has_mean <- length(object@mean) == 1
  has_sterr <- length(object@sterr) == 1
  has_lb <- length(object@lb) == 1
  has_ub <- length(object@ub) == 1
  
  option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
  option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
  
  if (option_1 | option_2) {
    return(TRUE)
  } else {
    stop("needs mean and sterr or lb and ub")
  }
})

setMethod("show", "waldCI",
  function(object) {
    cat(object@confidence_level)
    cat("\n")
    cat(object@mean)
    cat(object@sterr)
    return(invisible(object))
  }
)

setGeneric("confidence_level",
           function(x) {
             standardGeneric("confidence_level")
           })

setMethod("confidence_level", "confidence_level", function(x) x@confidence_level)

setGeneric("contains",
           function(object, value) {
             standardGeneric("contains")
           })

setMethod("contains", "waldCI",
  function(object, value) {
    
  has_mean <- length(object@mean) == 1
  has_sterr <- length(object@sterr) == 1
  has_lb <- length(object@lb) == 1
  has_ub <- length(object@ub) == 1
    
    option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
    option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
    
    if (option_1) {
      lb <- object@mean - (2 * object@sterr)
      ub <- object@mean - (2 * object@sterr)
      return(value > lb & value < ub)
    } else {
      return(value > object@lb & value < object@ub)
    }
  }
)

setGeneric("overlap", function(object_one, object_two) {
  standardGeneric("overlap")
})

setMethod("overlap",
          signature = c(object_one = "waldCI", object_two = "waldCI"),
  function(object_one, object_two) {
    
    has_mean <- length(object_one@mean) == 1
    has_sterr <- length(object_one@sterr) == 1
    has_lb <- length(object_one@lb) == 1
    has_ub <- length(object_one@ub) == 1
    
    option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
    option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
    
    lb_one <- 0
    ub_one <- 0
    
    if (option_1) {
      lb_one <- object_one@mean - (2 * object_one@sterr)
      ub_one <- object_one@mean - (2 * object_one@sterr)
    } else {
      lb_one <- object_one@lb
      ub_one <- object_one@ub
    }
    
    has_mean <- length(object_two@mean) == 1
    has_sterr <- length(object_two@sterr) == 1
    has_lb <- length(object_two@lb) == 1
    has_ub <- length(object_two@ub) == 1
    
    option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
    option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
    
    lb_two <- 0
    ub_two <- 0
    
    if (option_1) {
      lb_two <- object_two@mean - (2 * object_two@sterr)
      ub_two <- object_two@mean - (2 * object_two@sterr)
    } else {
      lb_two <- object_two@lb
      ub_two <- object_two@ub
    }
    
      overlap <- ((lb_one > lb_two & lb_one < ub_two) | (ub_one > lb_two & ub_one < ub_two) | (lb_two > lb_one & lb_two < ub_one) | (ub_two > lb_one & ub_two < ub_one))
  
  return(overlap)
      
  })
  


setMethod("as.numeric",
          signature = c(x = "waldCI"),
  function(x) {
    return(c(x@lb, x@ub))
})
```
